name: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN 'Triple Black'
story_html: Kanye West tapped industry legends Christian Tresser and Steven Smith for the adidas 700 MNVN. The sneaker's usual mixed-material profile is overhauled in favor of triple-black nylon designed with heat-welded panels and an enlarged 3M '700' graphic along the lateral. This revamp adds a heel tab and drops the Three-Stripes emblem. The Boost-enclosed midsole is paired with a herringbone-patterned rubber outsole.
